meta.note: Three Kages design systems share one token file. Core tokens are unprefixed; Ledger and Atelier tokens carry their system id as prefix. bundle.css maps each set onto the --kg-* variables components read, scoped by .kg-sys-<id>.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every block.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised blocks: cards, inputs, menus, tables.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed regions: sidebar, table header, tinted cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative, not a control edge).

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Edges of interactive controls (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper/surface/sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions (4.5:1 on paper/surface).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary actions and the active nav item marker. The identity colour.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected-row and active-item tint; ink text sits on it.

tokens.name: wire
tokens.usage: References and links between blocks: focus rings, ref highlights, links.

tokens.name: wire-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind wire-coloured badges.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive deltas and success text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, negative deltas, errors.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banners and danger badges; ink text sits on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every interactive control.
